Technovation is the world's largest accelerator for girls and young women. We journey to  North Carolina, where we hear directly from a passionate 12-year-old student who recently developed an AI-powered natural disaster rescue assistant that creates personalized emergency escape plans for crises like earthquakes, floods, wildfires and pandemics.
